description: Commission a security audit of Solidity or Rust/Anchor source files. THIS SPENDS REAL MONEY (USDC on Base, $1 per 10 files) — confirm with the user before calling it. Returns a jobId immediately; the audit runs for several minutes, so poll weakspot_audit_status with that jobId rather than expecting findings here.

description.description: What the project does, its trust assumptions, anything a reviewer should know. Optional but strongly recommended — it is the single biggest lever on false-positive rate.

files.description: Inline sources, for content not on disk.

paths.description: Paths to .sol/.rs files on disk, read by this server. Preferred over `files`.

verify.description: Default true. A second adversarial pass that re-checks every finding against the actual code and drops what does not hold up. Roughly doubles audit time. Set false only for a fast, noisy first look.

name: weakspot_audit
